sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Rook/Berserker/Morpher:
Reduces Unison Attack and Great Spirit Unison Attack damage of all elements taken by S.
The following will activate if your Class is Rook/Berserker/Morpher:
Increases status ailment resistance by S+.

[Activation Category]
Defense Awakening Constant Skill (up to 2 Constant Skills of the same category can be used at once).

[Activation]
Only activates when playing as Rook/Berserker/Morpher.

[Activation Rate]
Constant
